title: Making P-pop history: SB19, BINI nominated for 2027 Grammys
summary: The two P-pop groups are nominated under the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category

blocks.text: The two P-pop groups are nominated under the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category
MANILA, Philippines – History is made as P-pop groups SB19 and BINI are nominated for the 69th Grammy Awards.
The Recording Academy announced on Monday, November 16 (Manila time), that the two Filipino music acts were nominated under the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category.
SB19 received a nomination for the song “VISA,” while BINI was nominated for “Unang Kilig.”
“From the Philippines to the world, thank you for believing in SB19 and standing with us as we carry Filipino music to the global stage!” SB19 said about its nomination.

“A historic moment for OPM, for Filipino music, and for everyone who believes in them. The girls are making history, and we couldn’t be prouder! Thank you to everyone who continues to support us!” BINI wrote.

Under the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category, SB19 and BINI are joined by fellow nominees, K-pop girl groups IVE (“BANG BANG”) and KiiiKiii (“404 (New Era)”), Japanese soloist LiSA (“Yes”), and Japanese kawaii metal band BABYMETAL and American rock outfit Polyphia (“Sunset Kiss”).
SB19 and BINI’s nominations come at a time when the two groups have achieved several major milestones all year.

BINI became the first-ever homegrown Filipino music act to perform at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in April, while SB19 later achieved the same feat in July at Lollapalooza in Chicago.
SB19 will also be heading to Coachella in April 2027. Their inclusion in the lineup was just announced on November 11.
BINI, meanwhile, just wrapped up their 2026 BINI Signals World Tour in Taiwan on November 15. – Rappler.com
